slides.title: NGN NCLEX-RN Practice Question
text: The nurse is caring for a client who had a right mastectomy with breast reconstruction eight weeks ago. Upon assessment, the nurse notes the findings below. For each assessment finding, use an “X” to indicate whether the interventions were effective, ineffective, or unrelated.
Mastectomy and reconstruction incisions are healed without redness or drainage and show no signs of infection
Reports an inability to straighten the left arm
Right arm is edematous and much larger than the left arm
Reports intermittent heart palpitations after consuming caffeine
States that she has been attending group therapy and interacting with other individuals who have had a mastectomy
